candidates.title: Metro stations pilot predictive elevator safety monitoring
candidates.search_snippet: The metro began a station-elevator safety monitoring pilot using vibration and door-cycle data.
candidates.source_content: Synthetic metro engineering release. The metro began a predictive elevator safety-monitoring pilot at three stations. The release describes vibration sensing, door-cycle analysis, safety alerts, test results, and the operational decision process for station accessibility equipment.

contract_notes: A non-seven-system urban-rail equipment event can be reportable when it has sufficient technical, safety, operational, or demonstration value.
The empty taxonomy array means no reasonable mapping to the seven fixed systems.
This synthetic fixture must not be represented as a historical TransLink elevator case.
